hero.title: Flash Your Jade-Diy Directly from the Web
hero.description: Connect your device, select your model and board version, and start flashing immediately. No setup required.
hero.loggingDescription: Connect your device, log the serial data and download it later on.
hero.loggingDisclaimer: All firmware hosted on this site was personally compiled by Sandmann. I, Sandmann, do not assume responsibility for any misuse of the system or security failures. The purpose of this site is to let you easily install older Jade DIY versions for educational comparison and bug discovery. For real-world use I recommend compiling the Jade software yourself and installing it manually.

fastFlashing.title: Fast Flashing
fastFlashing.description: Flash your Jade-Diy in seconds, not minutes.

webBased.title: Web-Based
webBased.description: No need for special software. Use your web browser.

multipleBoards.title: Multiple Boards
multipleBoards.description: Support for various Jade-Diy boards and modules.

instructions.title: How to Use

steps.1: Connect your Jade-Diy to your computer.
steps.2: Click "Connect Device" and select your device from the popup.
steps.3: Select your device model from the dropdown.
steps.5: Click "Start Flashing" to begin the process.
steps.6: Wait for the flashing process to complete.
